brief:
The family of Palestinian journalist Mohammed Atiq has demanded his immediate release and disclosure of his detention location, Middle East Eye reported. Atiq was arrested by the Israeli army at dawn on Sunday.

The demand follows a pattern of detentions of Palestinian journalists and media workers by Israeli forces. No further details on the charges or circumstances of his arrest were provided.
dek: Family of Palestinian journalist Mohammed Atiq demands his release The family of Palestinian journalist Mohammed Atiq has demanded that his place of detention be disclosed and that he be released, following his arrest by the Israeli army at dawn on Sunday.
title: Family demands release of Palestinian journalist arrested by Israel
